dod_bridge_over_salzach = {
	is_shown = {
		c:BOH ?= this
		exists = c:DUA
		exists = c:VEN
		NOT = { has_global_variable = dod_salzach_pact }
	}
	possible = {
		is_at_war = no
	}
	when_taken = {
		set_global_variable = dod_salzach_pact
		change_relations = { country = c:DUA value = 40 }
		c:DUA = { change_relations = { country = root value = 40 } }
	}
	ai_chance = { value = 50 }
}
